messages:
tori_marketing: Need a concise bench + dashboard snapshot for the live launch demo. Requirements: streaming + function-call, warmup vs coldstart, quantized vs fp16 variants, and a clear fallback plan if fidelity drops. Artifacts + tiny sanitized prompt pack by EOD Tue.

sam_runtime: Copy. Which models and traffic shape? Also confirm you want a prebuilt dashboard image (png) showing p95 over time during warmup/coldstart.

tori_marketing: Models: open-3b-quant, open-7b-quant, open-7b-fp16. Traffic: simulated human typing (4 users, 3 short turns ~40 tokens, 1 long probe 1800 tokens). Yes include dashboard png (timeline p50/p90/p95), a short README, and provenance (harness SHA, seed). If eval fails for any quantized variant well fallback to 3b quant and need a short slide note.

owen_devx: Ill drop the harness snippet to reproduce typing + streaming. Use seed=4312 for determinism.

owen_devx: ```json
{
  "scenario":"live_demo",
  "users":4,
  "short_turns":3,
  "short_avg_tokens":40,
  "long_probe_tokens":1800,
  "typing_delay_ms_range":[30,120],
  "stream_chunk_ms":150,
  "function_call":true,
  "seed":4312
}
```

sam_runtime: Great. Plan: smoke quantized 3b/7b now low qps, full fp16 sweep tomorrow AM. Well capture perf.jsonl (per-request with chunk_index & chunk_latency_ms), metrics.csv (1s), dashboard.png, sanitized_prompts.json, and a README with run command and env (CUDA/toolkit + runtime tag). Example run command to include:```bash
redwood-bench --model open-7b-quant --profile live_demo --harness samples/live_harness.json --out ./artifacts/3743210000 --concurrency 4 --seed 4312
```

ida_eval: Ill prepare a 32-case function-call fidelity suite checking schema/arg correctness + a handful of long-context coherence checks. Ill output eval/results.csv and flag any prompt ids that fail. ETA tomorrow 10:30 PT.

benchbot: Queued run rb-2026-3743210000-A targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=live_demo, expected_duration=20m. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/3743210000_A/ on completion.

sam_runtime: Well also include a small fallback note for slides: if any variant fails fidelity checks, demo will use open-3b-quant and slide copy will say "3b quant selected for demo reliability; higher-quality fp16 available in prod." Well tag @tori_marketing when artifacts land.

tori_marketing: Perfect  thanks. Please tag @tori_marketing and @ida_eval when the artifact link is posted. If any regressions show up, call it out in the thread so we can swap the demo build. :thumbsup:
